# ==============================================================================
# SPECTROFLUOROMETER RAW EMISSION SPECTRA DATA
# Instrument: JASCO FP-8550 Spectrofluorometer (Serial Number: C023162067)
# Facility: Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT), Vellore, India
# Sample: Carbon Dots (L-Angiomer) aqueous dispersion (Stock: 500 µg/L)
# Light Source: Continuous 150 W Xenon arc lamp
# Measurement Type: Fluorescence Emission Spectrum (N = 5 independent scans)
# Excitation Wavelength (Ex WL): 360.0 nm
# Emission Range: 370.0 nm - 710.0 nm
# Data Interval (Delta X): 0.5 nm (681 data points per scan)
# Excitation Bandwidth (Ex Band): 5.0 nm
# Emission Bandwidth (Em Band): 5.0 nm
# Scan Speed: 1000 nm/min
# Response Time: 0.1 sec (Medium)
# Shutter Control: Open only for measurement
#
# IMPORTANT TECHNICAL NOTE ON DETECTOR SATURATION:
# Due to the high optical concentration of the 500 µg/L carbon dot aqueous stock,
# the emitted photon flux saturated the photomultiplier tube (PMT) detector at its
# upper ceiling of 10,000.0 counts between 370.0 nm and ~485.0 nm under 360.0 nm
# excitation. Consequently, this plateau reflects instrumental ceiling saturation
# rather than a true spectral maximum (lambda_max). The observable shoulder
# decaying monotonically from 485.0 nm to 710.0 nm demonstrates active visible
# photoluminescence across the blue-to-green and yellow-red spectral windows.
# ==============================================================================
